newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 5c to 562c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 5c to 562c/kg.

text.p: The Australian eastern wool market indicator rose a further five cents to 562 cents a kg clean at sales in Goulburn and Adelaide on Wednesday, Wool International (WI) said.
In a firmer merino fleece market, 19 micron was slightly dearer, 20m 0.5 percent dearer, 21/24/25m were 1.5 percent dearer and 22/23/26m were 1.0 percent dearer.
In merino skirtings, 19m was generally unchanged and 20/21m slightly dearer.
In crossbreds, 27/28/29m were 0.5 percent dearer, 30m slightly dearer and 31m 1.0 percent cheaper.
